description: Upcoming courses and training sessions with limited seats near a location or in a city, in-person ones nearest first, then by date. Online sessions are not limited by location. Only sessions still open for booking: canceled and past sessions are left out, a full session has seats.free 0 and waitlist true. Each session lists its dates, price or deposit, certificate and free seats. Nothing is booked: give the user the confirm_url. Times are in the studio time zone.

city.description: City name, used when no coordinates are known

from_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only courses that last until this day or later

query.description: Words the course title or description must contain, e.g. "gel"

radius_km.description: Search radius for in-person courses, default 25

to_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only courses that start on or before this day

name: find_courses
title: Find courses
